11.steps: Firmware setting is restored to Factory Default Settings. PC1 connects to X0 interface of the DUT, PC2 connects to X2 interface.
11.initial: This test case is designed to make sure the SSH management can take effects.
11.title: Function test of the SSH Management of interfaces
11.result:
1). Login to the FW from the default LAN interface; 2). Assign interface X2 as LAN zone and enter valid IP address with SSH management checked; 3). Navigate to Firewall>Access Rules, choose LAN>LAN matrix, make sure there is a rule "source: Any, Destination: All X2 Management IP, Service: SSH Management, Action: Allow, Users: All" added automatically; 4). From PC2, initial SSH connect to the interface X2, make sure the SSH session is setup; 5). Open the configure dialog of interface X2, and then un-check the SSH management, click OK, make sure the SSH session broken up;
  6). Navigate to Firewall>Access Rules, choose LAN>LAN matrix, make sure the rule disappeared; 7). From the PC2, connect to the interface X2, meanwhile, capture packets on FW, make sure the SSH packet dropped by FW; 8). Repeat those steps on other interfaces assigned to WAN and DMZ zone;
